source: Club banguide/hole notes and reviews gathered by the research pass; see course facts in the commit history.

1.note: Elevated tee over a wide inviting fairway - the deliberately friendly opener. Pond hard against the RIGHT edge of the green, running down the right from ~54 m short. Red-staked penalty area left of the road, continuous with the one behind green 2.

2.note: Shortest hole, 147 m. No open water; red-staked penalty area behind the green to the left.

3.note: SIGNATURE HOLE. Elevated tee; lake down the ENTIRE left side to a green set against the water behind a curving retaining wall. Dogleg LEFT around the lake. Only four distinct tee positions.

4.note: Long narrow pond almost the whole RIGHT side; fairway split by it, playing up the left then bending RIGHT past the end of the water. INTERN O/B down the right (holes 1/4). Cross-ditch rebuilt and moved toward the tees, and two greenside trees felled, in the winter 2023/24 work - check current imagery.

5.note: BLIND, bell protocol. Marked ditch with an INFINITE red-staked penalty area down the left past the green. Green 22 m deep, singled out by the architect. Rock right of the hole blocks visibility.

6.note: Longest par 3 at 204 m - the value that settles the 6192 vs 6171 m total. Pond immediately front-left of the green, sand right; penalty area left and behind is INFINITE. Electric fence relief rule applies.

7.note: Stroke index 1, longest par 4 at 415 m, plays +23 m UPHILL. Red-staked penalty areas in the trees both sides, no open water. The approach over open farmland behind the green is Svensk Golf's 'most beautiful spot'.

8.note: Pond right in the drive/second-shot zone (209-242 m from the green). INTERN O/B right (holes 8/15). Red-and-green ELECTRIC FENCE, infinite penalty area with no-play zone, down the LEFT.

9.note: Bends gently RIGHT. No water now; Kains lists expanding water between 9 and 11 as future work. Nine ends near the clubhouse by design.

10.note: No water. Sits at the seam of the two rebuild phases (11-18 done 2008, 1-10 done 2009).

11.note: Pond LEFT of the green, near edge ~56 m short. Bends slightly left near the green. Electric fence down the RIGHT.

12.note: LONGEST HOLE, 521 m. Long lake down the LEFT through the second-shot and layup zone, ~92-248 m out. Green 28 m deep. Electric fence down the RIGHT.

13.note: Lake the ENTIRE left side, tee to green. Plan marks START KULLAR / SLUT KULLAR down the right - an explicit run of shaped mounding. Bends slightly left near the green.

15.note: Index 2 at only 337 m. Pond RIGHT in the approach zone (67-110 m out), O/B left, bends LEFT with the pond inside the right corner. The architect says the intended design had the water LEFT and the fairway RIGHT - the built hole is a compromise. INTERN O/B on the 8th side.

16.note: BLIND, bell protocol. Crossing DIKE at 131 m from the green. Bends gently RIGHT. Architect singles out the approach; suggests raising the tees with material from 15.

17.note: Shortest par 4 (270 m) and index 18, but plays +14 m UPHILL. DIKE at 100 m from the green. Green 25 m deep. Architect singles out the bunkering here.

18.note: Distinct DOGLEG LEFT to a green beside the clubhouse. Architect singles out the tee shot. The green-and-clubhouse view in low sun is Svensk Golf's other 'most beautiful spot'. Three tees share 287 m.
